description: Darts Score Tracker — 501/301 countdown for two players with checkout suggestions, bust handling and leg tracking.

faqs.a: A visit busts if it scores more than your remaining total, leaves exactly 1, or reaches exactly 0 without the final dart being a double (bull counts as double).
faqs.q: When is a visit a bust?

faqs.a: To win a leg you must reach exactly 0 with your final dart landing in a double segment — or the bull, which counts as a double.
faqs.q: How do I win a leg?

faqs.a: Before every visit the tracker shows the standard checkout for your remaining score (up to 170), computed from real darts math.

howto: Pick 501 or 301 and enter player names.
Type each visit's 3 dart scores (0–60) and tick “final dart was a double” when it was.
Submit — busts are handled automatically, legs are counted.
Watch the checkout suggestion before each visit.
title: Darts Score Tracker
